import html # Template for the invitation. The placeholders will be replaced with sanitized values. INVITATION_FORMAT = """

{event_title}

{event_description}

Date: {event_date}

{additional_notes}
""" def render_event_invitation(event_title: str, event_description: str, event_date: str, additional_notes: str) -> str: """ Render a sanitized HTML invitation from user‑provided data. Parameters ---------- event_title : str Title of the event. event_description : str Full description (may contain line breaks or formatting characters). event_date : str Date of the event. additional_notes : str Any extra notes supplied by the user. Returns ------- str Sanitized HTML string ready for rendering in a browser. """ # Escape all user inputs to neutralize special characters that could # break HTML structure or introduce XSS vulnerabilities. safe_title = html.escape(event_title, quote=True) # Preserve line breaks in the description by converting \n to
. safe_description = html.escape(event_description, quote=True).replace("\n", "
") safe_date = html.escape(event_date, quote=True) safe_notes = html.escape(additional_notes, quote=True).replace("\n", "
") return INVITATION_FORMAT.format( event_title=safe_title, event_description=safe_description, event_date=safe_date, additional_notes=safe_notes )
